findings.finding: Carpet-bag appears as a modern-ish duffel/satchel rather than a 19th-century carpet-bag.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael holds a soft brown bag with a rounded, gathered/rolled top and uniform material, lacking the mottled fabric body and framed/rectangular mouth typical of a carpet-bag.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the bag as a small 19th-century carpet-bag: mottled fabric body with scuffed leather trim and short handles, a soft-sided rectangular silhouette with a short top opening; no zippers or modern seam details; keep it tucked under Ishmael’s arm.

findings.finding: Patched boots are not clearly patched or thin-soled as specified.
findings.visible_evidence: The ankle boots look intact with smooth toes and no obvious toe patches or thinning soles visible.
findings.repair_prompt: Weather and age the boots: add rough toe patches, scuffs, stitching repairs, and thinner worn soles; avoid a clean or sturdy appearance.

findings.finding: Legible lettering/details visible on the coins, violating the no readable text rule and modern-currency ambiguity.
findings.visible_evidence: Top coin in Ishmael’s gloved palm shows a distinct rim with engraved letters around a profile that are partially readable.
findings.repair_prompt: Render the coins as small, tarnished silver with indistinct, worn faces; remove any legible letters or numerals; avoid crisp modern edges; reduce contrast and detail so no text is readable.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag reads as a modern patterned handbag with a structured body and repeating logo-like motif.
findings.visible_evidence: Bag under Ishmael’s arm has a rigid, rounded shape with uniform decorative patterning and hardware rings, resembling a contemporary designer purse.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace with a 19th-century small, soft-sided carpet-bag of mottled fabric and scuffed leather trim; no repeating logos or modern hardware; make it slouch slightly under the arm with muted, worn materials.

findings.finding: Patched boots lack clearly visible toe patches specified for Ishmael.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots appear worn and scuffed but do not show distinct rough toe patches.
findings.repair_prompt: Add rough toe patches and evident sole wear to Ishmael’s dark leather ankle boots; keep the finish matte and battered.

findings.finding: Framing is closer to a full-body shot rather than the requested medium three-quarter view.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is shown head-to-toe within the frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Reframe to a medium three-quarter view (crop above the knees) while keeping Ishmael studying a few coins and hugging the carpet-bag; preserve clean negative space at bottom-center for the caption.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag appears rigid like a framed doctor’s/Gladstone bag rather than a soft-sided carpet-bag.
findings.visible_evidence: The bag under Ishmael’s arm has a stiff metal frame and structured shape with a hinged clasp, holding its form firmly.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the carpet-bag to be small and soft-sided with a slight sag, mottled worn fabric and leather trim, minimizing any rigid frame; keep it scuffed and 19th-century with no readable text.

findings.finding: Boots look worn but lack the clearly visible rough toe patches specified.
findings.visible_evidence: The front boot shows scuffs yet no distinct patching on the toes is visible.
findings.repair_prompt: Add obvious rough leather toe patches and thin, well-worn soles to Ishmael’s ankle boots; keep them dull and battered, avoiding modern tread.

findings.finding: The turn into a darker side street is not clearly depicted; he appears to continue along the main street.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael strides past the inn toward the open downhill street; no distinct side-lane branching or turning motion is emphasized.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose so a darker side lane branches off downhill toward the water, and angle Ishmael’s body/footprints to clearly show him turning into that lane while passing the bright inn door.

findings.finding: Ash-box appears as an active brazier with glowing embers and smoke rather than a box of gray stove ashes with an ajar lid.
findings.visible_evidence: At the right-side threshold, the low wooden box shows orange glow and curling smoke; no lid is present, suggesting live coals.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the embering contents with fine gray ash only; remove orange glow and active smoke. Add a slightly ajar lid and dusted ash around the box. Keep it low, wooden or tin, and positioned at the porch corner by the threshold.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s coughing is not visually indicated, only his retreat is shown.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is half-turned with one hand on the doorframe and the carpet-bag tucked, but his mouth is closed and no cough plume or gesture is present.
findings.repair_prompt: Indicate a subtle cough as he retreats: open his mouth slightly with a faint wisp of ash motes near his face, or a hunched shoulder/hand-near-mouth gesture, without adding text or balloons.

findings.finding: Congregants are rendered with detailed, lit faces rather than dim silhouettes.
findings.visible_evidence: Multiple worshipers’ faces and garments are clearly detailed and well-lit across the pews.
findings.repair_prompt: Push congregants into dimmer, silhouette-like lighting consistent with lamplight: reduce facial detail and contrast so they read as bundled silhouettes facing the pulpit while still glancing toward the disturbance.

findings.finding: Top-center caption zone is occupied and visually busy.
findings.visible_evidence: A large wooden swinging sign and its chains occupy the top-center area, with dense sleet across the same region.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose so the top-center has clean negative sky: shift the sign leftward (upper-left quadrant) and/or lower it, open a clear band of darker sky at top-center, and reduce sleet density in that band by 30%. Keep the sign text-free and weathered.

findings.finding: Door hardware shown as a round knob instead of the specified latch.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael’s right hand grips a round doorknob on the inn door.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the knob with a simple 19th-century iron thumb-latch or latch handle; keep Ishmael’s hand reaching for the latch and retain the weathered wooden door.

findings.finding: Required prop ‘patched boots’ are not visible in the frame.
findings.visible_evidence: The composition crops at mid-thigh; Ishmael’s feet/boots are out of frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Adjust framing or pose to reveal Ishmael’s lower legs and worn ankle boots with visible toe patches, keeping the low-angle medium shot feel.

findings.visible_evidence: Two small human figures are seen down the dockside street near lamplights.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove or obscure distant pedestrians with sleet and darkness so only Ishmael is discernible; retain masts, posts, and lamplight.
